en: The Analysis of the Bhikkhunī Rules,
2.10 Section on Failures (Vipattivāra) Regarding the offenses due to consenting to physical contact: to how many of the four failures do these offenses belong?
The offenses due to consenting to physical contact belong to two of the four failures.

There may be a failure in virtue; there may be a failure in conduct … [as above] … Regarding the offenses caused by requesting and eating curd, to how many of the four failures do these offenses belong?
The offenses caused by requesting and eating curd belong to one of the four failures—namely, failure in conduct.
The third section on failure is finished.
